name: cutgenie
description: Edit videos in Cutgenie by chatting with Claude: cut pauses, trim, titles, zooms, sound, colour, blur and export.
long_description:
Lets Claude edit the project open in **Cutgenie**, the macOS video editor, on this Mac. Ask in plain words, for example *cut the pauses out of my intro* or *export it for YouTube*.

Safety: your original video and sound files are never changed. A version of the project is saved before the first edit, mistakes are undone, and an existing export is only replaced after you say yes. Cutgenie only accepts commands from this Mac.

port.title: Cutgenie port
port.description: The port Cutgenie listens on. Leave it at 7878 unless you changed CUTGENIE_PORT.

tools.name: cutgenie_status
tools.description: Check that Cutgenie is open and which project is loaded.

tools.name: cutgenie_get_project
tools.description: Read the clips, graphics, sound and markers of the open project.

tools.name: cutgenie_command
tools.description: Run one editing command (split, trim, remove a range, text, zoom, colour, volume…).

tools.name: cutgenie_save
tools.description: Save the project (the old file is kept as a version).

tools.name: cutgenie_render_frame
tools.description: Show the edited picture at a time.

tools.name: cutgenie_find_silences
tools.description: Find silent pauses in a clip's file (read only).

tools.name: cutgenie_export
tools.description: Export a video or sound file; never replaces a file without a yes.
